requirements.name: go-parser-architecture
requirements.text: The implementation language is Go, fixed by this Target's `TECHNOLOGY_STACK.md` and governed by `stack/go.md`.

requirements.name: stdin-tagged-json-contract
requirements.text: The program is a filter: read TOML from **stdin**, write tagged JSON to **stdout**, exit `0`.

requirements.name: reject-invalid-toml
requirements.text: On invalid TOML, write a diagnostic to **stderr** and exit non-zero.

requirements.name: tagged-json-encoding
requirements.text: Every TOML **value** becomes `{"type": "<TOML_TYPE>", "value": "<TOML_VALUE>"}`.

requirements.name: parse-strings
requirements.text: basic and literal strings, then multi-line strings with their line-ending backslash and trimming rules.

requirements.name: parse-scalars
requirements.text: **Scalars** — booleans, integers (including `0x`, `0o`, `0b`, underscores), floats (including `inf`, `nan`, exponents), basic and literal strings, then

requirements.name: parse-datetimes
requirements.text: **Datetimes** — offset, local datetime, local date, local time.

requirements.name: process-lexical-input
requirements.text:
**Scaffolding** — line handling, comments, whitespace, the stdin/stdout/exit
   contract, tagged JSON emission.

requirements.name: parse-key-forms
requirements.text: **Keys** — bare, quoted, and dotted keys; the redefinition rules.

requirements.name: parse-arrays
requirements.text:
**Inline tables and arrays** — including nesting and the TOML 1.0 restriction
   that inline tables are closed to later extension.

requirements.name: enforce-key-semantics
requirements.text:
**Invalid-input hardening** — control characters, bad UTF-8, duplicate keys,
   redefinition after an inline table, unterminated constructs.

requirements.name: parse-inline-tables
requirements.text:
**Inline tables and arrays** — including nesting and the TOML 1.0 restriction
   that inline tables are closed to later extension.

requirements.name: close-inline-tables
requirements.text: the TOML 1.0 restriction that inline tables are closed to later extension.

requirements.name: parse-standard-tables
requirements.text: **Tables** — `[table]`, `[a.b.c]` implicit creation, `[[array of tables]]`,

requirements.name: reject-table-redefinitions
requirements.text: and the rules governing which of these may follow which.

requirements.name: parse-arrays-of-tables
requirements.text: `[[array of tables]]`

requirements.name: enforce-array-table-ordering
requirements.text: the rules governing which of these may follow which.

requirements.name: pass-conformance-suite
requirements.text:
Every supplied valid and invalid case passes: the failed, errored, and skipped
counts are all zero.

requirements.name: pin-test-version
requirements.text: The version setup_harness.sh installs. run_conformance.sh refuses a different one, so a passing verdict names a specific exam rather than whichever harness was on PATH.

requirements.name: build-decoder
requirements.text: go build -o toml-decoder ./cmd/toml-decoder

requirements.name: run-conformance-suite
requirements.text: DECODER="$PWD/toml-decoder" exec sh sources/run_conformance.sh

requirements.name: run-toml-conformance
requirements.text: Run the upstream toml-test conformance suite against the built decoder.

requirements.name: select-conformance-tests
requirements.text:
DECODER=./toml-decoder sh sources/run_conformance.sh -run 'valid/string/*'  # one group
DECODER=./toml-decoder sh sources/run_conformance.sh -json                  # machine-readable

requirements.name: require-decoder-command
requirements.text:
DECODER    decoder command. Required — this harness is language-neutral and
              deliberately has no default implementation language.

requirements.name: resolve-test-harness
requirements.text: TOML_TEST  absolute path to the toml-test binary (default: found on PATH)

requirements.name: pin-harness-version
requirements.text: The suite's identity is part of the verdict.

requirements.name: return-harness-verdict
requirements.text: Exit code is the harness exit code: 0 only when every test passes.

requirements.name: install-conformance-harness
requirements.text:
# One-time installation of the upstream toml-test conformance harness.
...
GOBIN="${GOBIN:-$HOME/.local/bin}"
...
GOBIN="${GOBIN}" go install \
    "github.com/toml-lang/toml-test/v2/cmd/toml-test@${TOML_TEST_VERSION}"

requirements.name: run-conformance-slice
requirements.text: Same contract as full_test.sh, scoped to the cases a single story owns: build the decoder, then run the installed toml-test suite over the pattern given as $1.

requirements.name: preserve-verdict
requirements.text: Exit status is the verdict and the whole verdict. Do not filter, skip, or reinterpret.

requirements.name: document-lexing
requirements.text: A TOML file must be a valid UTF-8 encoded Unicode document.

requirements.name: comments
requirements.text: A hash symbol marks the rest of the line as a comment, except when inside a string.

requirements.name: key-forms
requirements.text: A key may be either bare, quoted, or dotted.

requirements.name: key-semantics
requirements.text: Defining a key multiple times is invalid.

requirements.name: string-forms
requirements.text: There are four ways to express strings: basic, multi-line basic, literal, and multi-line literal.

requirements.name: numeric-values
requirements.text: Integers are whole numbers.

requirements.name: floating-point-values
requirements.text: Floats should be implemented as IEEE 754 binary64 values.

requirements.name: boolean-values
requirements.text: Booleans are just the tokens you're used to. Always lowercase.

requirements.name: date-time-values
requirements.text: To unambiguously represent a specific instant in time, you may use an RFC 3339 formatted date-time with offset.

requirements.name: arrays
requirements.text: Arrays are square brackets with values inside.

requirements.name: standard-tables
requirements.text: Tables (also known as hash tables or dictionaries) are collections of key/value pairs.

requirements.name: table-redefinition
requirements.text: Like keys, you cannot define a table more than once. Doing so is invalid.

requirements.name: inline-tables
requirements.text: Inline tables provide a more compact syntax for expressing tables.

requirements.name: inline-table-closure
requirements.text: Inline tables are fully self-contained and define all keys and sub-tables within them. Keys and sub-tables cannot be added outside the braces.

requirements.name: arrays-of-tables
requirements.text: The last syntax that has not yet been described allows writing arrays of tables.

requirements.name: arrays-of-tables-ordering
requirements.text: If the parent of a table or array of tables is an array element, that element must already have been defined before the child can be defined.

requirements.name: filename-extension
requirements.text: TOML files should use the extension `.toml`.

requirements.name: mime-type
requirements.text: When transferring TOML files over the internet, the appropriate MIME type is `application/toml`.
